params.name: time
params.description: Evaluation timestamp in RFC3339 or Unix timestamp format. Defaults to current server time.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Evaluation timeout. Defaults to server-configured timeout.

params.name: dedup
params.description: If true, enables deduplication of time series from replicated Prometheus instances. Defaults to true.

params.name: partial_response
params.description: If true, enables partial response. If a store is unavailable, partial data will be returned with a warning instead of failing the query.

params.name: max_source_resolution
params.description: Maximum source resolution to use for the query. Can be 0s, 5m, or 1h. Selects the appropriate downsampled data when available.

params.name: engine
params.description: Query engine to use. Thanos supports the default Prometheus engine and the Thanos engine for distributed execution.

params.name: step
